name: Fusaishi Haruaki
source:
Occupation: Graduate Student
Stay as: Visitor

After a motorbike accident in the middle of the forest, Haruaki arrives in the settlement of Yasumizu. At first sight, he appears to be a well-behaved young man—but there is more to him than meets the eye.

For reasons unknown, Haruaki loops back in time after his death, only to re-live his life from the day of the 11th of May over again.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
